# Homework

This section records deadlines, personal progress, and work I am allowed to publish. It does not reproduce the instructor’s questions, answer forms, data, or restricted files.

## Documented structure

| Item | Role | Points |
|---|---|---:|
| Homework 0 | Optional introductory extra credit | Up to 2 |
| Homework 1–4 | Four graded assignments | 80 total |
| Homework 4 | Final report using the student’s own data | Included above |

The syllabus states that homework is usually released on Monday morning and due by the end of the next Monday’s workday. Microsoft Forms and Blackboard are the official submission channels described by the instructor.
